messages:
priya: T-minus 6h to release. Quick preflight check — version bump + changelog merged? Branch freeze in place? CI green sweep + flaky triage status? I'll list assignments below.

darren: version bump + changelog PR merged (refs #421). @julia can you confirm changelog entry format?

julia: checked changelog — formatting looks good, added migration note and cross-ref. :white_check_mark:

kevin: branch freeze applied to main and release/*, merge queue paused. Affected repos: runtime, infra, console. Watchlist updated at /rel/watchlist.md

priya: thanks. Can someone kick a targeted CI sweep for the release matrix? Prefer Buildkite pipeline "release-preflight" or run the script:
```
./scripts/ci/smoke-sweep.sh --tag release --parallel 6
```

ops-bot: Buildkite: queued job 6789 for "release-preflight" (triggered by @kevin). ETA ~12m.

darren: I'm on flaky triage — running flaky-locator over last 24h failures. Early signal: 3 notable flakes -> runtime::kvcache-evict, tests::integration::scheduler, docs::link-check. Will surface skip candidates if no root cause in 30m.

julia: I can take docs::link-check. Quick grep shows one flaky external URL; will pin to snapshot and re-run.

kevin: runtime::kvcache-evict looks correlated with kernel image bump on dedicated nodes. Opened hotfix branch and running e2e. Draft PR #425. If it persists, fallback = pin older kernel image for release nodes.

sam: FYI dedicated capacity autoscaler will be less responsive during the release window; avoid scheduling heavy load tests until post-cutover.

priya: assignment summary: @darren => runtime + integration flaky investigation, @julia => docs link-check, @kevin => infra hotfix & rollback plan. If any blocker remains after ops-bot green, we'll decide gated rollout vs rollback.

darren: will post a quick status in 20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: Buildkite: job 6789 passed — all pipelines in the release matrix are green. :sparkles:

priya: excellent. @darren hold final acceptance for 15m then I'll flip the cutoff. Reminder: cutoff is 6:00pm PT.

kevin: ack. Keeping the merge queue locked until cutover confirm.

julia: changelog published to release notes site.

darren: runtime flaky fixed in #425, integration tests stable locally now. Marked non-blocking.

priya: thanks team — if anything else comes up drop it here. I'll post final cutoff once I flip the release tag. :rocket:
